seoTitle: Conversion Rate Calculator with Target Conversions Needed
metaDescription: Calculate conversion rate from visitors and conversions, and see how many conversions or visitors you need to hit a target. Free and private.
intro: Enter visitors and conversions for the rate, and a target rate for what it takes to reach it.
why:
The rate is simple, but the target view is what helps planning: how many more conversions a 3% goal means on the same traffic, and how much traffic the current rate would need.

Define visitors the same way as your analytics tool (sessions or users), and conversions as one event, or the rate is not comparable between sources.
howTo: Enter a target rate, or 0 to skip.
Read the rate and the gap.
Use the A/B tools to plan improvements.

faq.a: Use whichever your analytics reports, and stay consistent.
It varies a lot by site and goal; compare with your own history.
Not here, since each visitor counts at most once.
